svg.text: ARCADE / LED and HDMI electrical interfaces
U1 and U2 are the exact DIP-20 parts on the DigiKey invoice. Grounds are shared; positive rails stay separate.

g.text: A -> B; A2-A8 GND; B2-B8 NC
U1 pin 18 is 5 V output: connect only to the LED chain.
U1 pin 20 = +5 V LED; pin 1 = +5 V; pin 19 = GND.
C1 = 100 nF ceramic directly across U1 pins 20 and 10.
C3 = 1000 uF / >=10 V across strip input (+ to +5 V).
Add 100 nF at each bare pixel if its board lacks decoupling.
Fourth pixel optional: for three pixels leave LED3 DOUT open.
Final pixel DOUT is always unconnected. Power is parallel.
A -> B; A2-A8 GND; B2-B8 NC
Dry contact; no Due / Pi connection
The silver button connects directly across the switch button contacts.
No Pi GPIO, Due D9, NPN transistor, R2 or R3 is used for switching.
STATUS_5V -> U2 -> Due D8; verify HIGH means Pi is selected.
D8 HIGH: USB keyboard active; both NES data outputs released.
D8 LOW: USB keys released; two NES controller ports active.
If status polarity is opposite, invert the firmware polarity setting.

svg.text: ARCADE | 2026-10-14 | Wiring documentation - logical connector positions; no PCB fabrication.
